name: Witch Doctor: self stat-percentage passives work natively (#1198, #1326, #3648)
contract: Juju Injection 503608/503609 ("Increases your Agility and Intellect by $s1%"): two SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE (137) effects, MiscValue 1=STAT_AGILITY and 3=STAT_INTELLECT, EffectBasePoints 4/9 (DieSides 1, so 5%/10%). Loa's Strength 705936/705937 ("Increases your Agility and your Nature and Shadow damage dealt by $s1%"): effect0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (79) MiscValue 40 = Nature(8)|Shadow(32) school mask, EffectBasePoints 2/5 (3%/6%); effect1 aura 137 MiscValue 1 = Agility, same amount. Staff of the Coven 806563/807905/807915 ("Increases your Spirit by $s1% and your hit chance by $s2%"): effect0 aura 137 MiscValue 4=STAT_SPIRIT, EffectBasePoints 7/15/24 (8%/16%/25%); effect1 the custom SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT (333), EffectBasePoints 1/3/5 (2%/4%/6%). All 15 records carry SpellFamilyName 19 (Witch Doctor) and SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE, so Player::addSpell (Player.cpp:3363) self-casts them on learn. Handlers: aura 137 -> AuraEffect::HandleModTotalPercentStat (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4510) -> Unit::SetStatPctModifier, generic and misc-value-driven; aura 79 -> AuraEffect::HandleModDamagePercentDone, read by Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone via school mask; aura 333 -> AuraEffect::HandleAscensionModHitChanceAll (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:398), folded into melee/ranged/spell hit chance at StatSystem.cpp:999,1005,1011 (a generic, already-wired Ascension core feature, not module code). None of these 15 spell ids appear anywhere under src/server/coa/ or modules/mod-ascension/, confirming the tooltip is delivered purely by the generic aura system. None of the rank pairs/triples are registered in the `spell_ranks` SQL table (SpellMgr::LoadSpellRanks, SpellMgr.cpp:1310), so SpellInfo::IsRanked() is false for all of them and Player::addSpell's automatic rank-supersede branch (Player.cpp:3251-3286) never fires; this scenario explicitly unlearns the previous rank before learning the next one instead of relying on automatic supersession. Probe spells for the school-mask check: Malefic Wrath 807037 (SchoolMask 8 = Nature, SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE) and Voodoo Fire 500473 (SchoolMask 4 = Fire, SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, unaffected by the 40 = Nature|Shadow mask) are both DoctorSpells-family (19) offensive spells; spell_damage_done does not require the probe spell to be known (bloodmage-atheranns-wickedness.json and felsworn-black-magic.json query unlearned/unowned spell ids the same way).
